column2: Let us give our condolences the families of the victims.
Why must the innocent die in such disasters?
Does Poseidon hunger for such destruction?
Do the gods mean to spite us?!
The ground erupts and swallows all in its wake.
Life is a bridge. Cross over it, but build no house on it.
Thank God the fatalities were so low!
There is no death, only a change of worlds.
Nacemos solos, vivimos solos, morimos solos.
Death spares neither Pope nor beggar.
At least they recovered within a year.
The happiest life ends before death.
